content:
Apple analysts and most netizens agree that Vision Pro paired with Apple's "Friday Night Baseball" offers an immersive experience that is currently the best way to watch baseball.

It is worth noting that there also seems to be a consensus that when it comes to various immersive camera angles, less is more……

Michael Simon of Macworld wins this round's best headline award with the title "Apple finally hits a home run in the VR world."

John Gruber of Daring Fireball is equally thrilled.

Jason Snell of Six Colors is more measured in his wording, but is likewise a Vision Pro supporter.

He points out that Apple cut back on frequent switching between different cameras in this baseball clip compared with the earlier basketball clip, and he highly praises this move, with others agreeing.

After watching a clip shared on X by Justin Ryan of Spatial Insider, this approach indeed seems to achieve the best of both worlds.

While I personally think that for most TV and movie viewing experiences, a face-mounted display that costs far less and weighs much lighter would be more practical, I absolutely understand the appeal of Vision Pro for this kind of fully immersive experience. I'm still waiting for the perfect compromise product.
